sources.title: [PATCH v5 08/10] media: v4l2-subdev: Move subdev client capabilities into a new struct

claims.claim: Add struct v4l2_subdev_client_info to hold sub-device client capability bits that used to be stored in the client_caps field of struct v4l2_subdev_fh. The intent is to enable passing this struct to sub-device pad operation callbacks for capability information.
